provenance: Written for WhyNot Cut by its own team from everyday Arabic (Egyptian forms included) and English vocabulary; no third-party word list was copied or adapted (K0 rule 5 licence check: nothing to attribute).
licence: GPL-3.0-or-later, as part of WhyNot Cut
_syntax: terms: words separated by spaces form a phrase; a trailing * on a word matches any ending; an Arabic word also matches after a joined prefix (و ف ب ل ك ال, the Egyptian بـ/هـ verb prefixes); Latin words ignore case unless the rule says case: true. pattern: a regular expression over the normalised text (no diacritics or tatweel, one alef, ى as ي, ة as ه, Arabic-Indic digits as 0-9, ٪ as %); flags i ignores case. supporting rules are reported only on a line where a rule hit. zones (a scripture quotation) count for this domain, and no other domain's words inside them are reported. Detection is a hint for the reviewer, never a filter.
